note: THE PINNED ORGΛNON DESIGN SYSTEM (Surface sprint; X-SURFACE a). The single source of truth for the surface: the stylesheet (public/organon.css) is BUILT from this file deterministically (script/build-stylesheet.ts); a changed token ⇒ a changed file ⇒ a changed surface-pins sha ⇒ a conscious re-pin, never a silent restyle. Colors are authored in OKLCH design-intent and expressed as sRGB hex for universal support AND deterministic WCAG-AA verification (surface_a11y). The SEMANTIC tokens each carry a non-color cue (glyph/border/weight — never color alone; a11y + honesty). The FACTS are the loudest thing on the screen; everything else recedes. Serious, precise, quiet — an instrument of reason, not a casino.

meta.name: ORGΛNON
meta.register: product — a professional analytical tool (design SERVES the facts; it is never the product)
meta.colorSpaceNote: authored in OKLCH, expressed as sRGB hex — hex is universal AND lets surface_a11y compute WCAG contrast deterministically from the token file

semantic.note: each entry: {color (text/mark on the dark ground), tint (a subtle same-hue fill), cue (the NON-COLOR distinction — a glyph, border-style, or weight — so the meaning survives greyscale + colorblindness)}. The pill/badge text is the WORD itself (a text cue); the glyph + border-style reinforce it. Cues render via CSS keyed on the existing semantic class — the HTML content is byte-untouched (S36).

FACT.cue: the high-trust tier — heaviest weight, a solid full border, a '✓' eyebrow; the engine-fact treatment

REASONING.cue: the visible 'ANALYSIS — not an engine fact' eyebrow label rendered adjacent (a screenshot carries it — V4); visibly secondary weight

BOUNDARY.cue: the honest edge — a DASHED full border (a non-color pattern cue) + muted weight

REAL.cue: a '●' filled mark + a SOLID border + the word REAL

SAMPLE.cue: a '○' hollow mark + a DASHED border + the word SAMPLE

AVOID.cue: a warning triangle '▲' + the word AVOID

type.monoStack: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
type.pairingNote: one system sans in multiple weights for prose + a mono for metrics/numbers — a legitimate contrast-axis pairing (geometric-sans ⊕ mono), never two near-identical sans

motion.easingNote: ease-out (quint-like); NO bounce, NO elastic (the detector enforces it)
motion.reducedMotion: every transition collapses to an instant/crossfade under @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)
motion.principle: motion is purposeful + minimal — a state change, never decoration; no reveal gates content visibility

a11y.nonColorCueRequired: every verdict / Stamp / REAL-SAMPLE / trust-tier distinction carries a non-color cue (glyph, border-style, or weight) — NEVER color alone (verified by surface_a11y)
a11y.keyboard: every interactive element (links, the Simple/Pro toggle, the form) is keyboard-reachable with a visible :focus-visible ring
a11y.responsive: the single-column layout is fluid to the mobile breakpoint; touch targets ≥ 40px; no horizontal scroll
